dogecoin.text: @bryb1205 I thought it had some funny parts. A bit self-deprecating humor. I suspect Dogecoin will recover. But I am too conservative to put real money in it. My opinion is that it is driven by hype and we don’t know when that hype will end when people want to cash out.

@bryb1205 He called it a hustle, but it was part of a Weekend Update bit (basically the anchors kept trying to get him to explain what Dogecoin was, and they ultimately agreed it was a hustle). He also said, "to the moon!" but it was down during the show.
